cli.stdout:
usage: verify_cache.py [-h] [--zig ZIG]
                       [--profile {quick,complete,long-qualification}]
                       [--quick-actions QUICK_ACTIONS] [--force]
                       [--shared-cache-dir SHARED_CACHE_DIR]
                       [--build-timeout-seconds BUILD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
                       [--gate-timeout-seconds GATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
                       [--warn-after-seconds WARN_AFTER_SECONDS]
                       [--budget-policy BUDGET_POLICY]
                       ...

Run the complete verification inventory, reusing qualified successes before
admission. python3 scripts/verify_cache.py --zig /path/to/pinned/zig python3
scripts/verify_cache.py --force -- -j3 --maxrss 8589934592 This developer
entry point owns build/gate admission; do not wrap it in another build-slot
invocation. Normal `zig build test fmt-check` remains supported. Receipts are
local evidence, never a replacement for an unregistered gate action.

positional arguments:
  options

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --zig ZIG
  --profile {quick,complete,long-qualification}
  --quick-actions QUICK_ACTIONS
                        Maximum quick-profile pending actions; heuristic and
                        partial
  --force               Ignore prior successes for the requested profile
  --shared-cache-dir SHARED_CACHE_DIR
                        Explicit local shared success evidence; inventory and
                        runs stay private
  --build-timeout-seconds BUILD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        Optional deadline per admitted preparation command;
                        excludes queue time
  --gate-timeout-seconds GATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        Optional deadline for the admitted selected gate;
                        excludes queue time
  --warn-after-seconds WARN_AFTER_SECONDS
                        Advisory total work target excluding admission queues;
                        never changes reuse or pass/fail
  --budget-policy BUDGET_POLICY
                        Optional v1 report-only scoped policy; never changes
                        reuse or pass/fail
